Snehal Patil

Pune, Maharashtra, India

Mobile: +91-7020197720 | Email: snehalpatil5100.sp@gmail.com

LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/snehalpatil5100/

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Certified SAFe® AI empowered POPM Senior Business Analyst & Product Owner with 15+ years of experience leading regulatory-driven payment transformation programs for global banks. Expert in ISO 20022, MT-to-MX migration, and high-volume clearing and settlement platforms. Known for end-to-end ownership — from regulatory interpretation and backlog prioritisation to delivery governance and production readiness within SAFe® and Agile environments.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Payments and Regulatory Domain

Payment Processing | Cash Management | Clearing and Settlement | Netting | Reconciliation | SWIFT MT/MX | ISO20022

| MT to MX Migration | RTGS | ACH | SEPA | CHAPS | Cross-Border Payments | Real-Time Payments | FIX Messaging

Product Ownership and Delivery Leadership

Product Roadmap | Backlog Prioritization | Feature Prioritization | Sprint Planning | Release Planning | PI Planning | Value Delivery | Stakeholder Management | Product Vision | | SDLC (Waterfall and Agile) | SAFe® 6

Business Analysis and Requirements

Requirements Gathering | BRD/FRD | Functional Specifications | User Stories | Acceptance Criteria | Use Cases | Process Mapping | As-Is/To-Be | Gap Analysis | Data Analysis | Workflow Analysis | UAT | AML | RAID |RACI

Technical Skills and Tools

SQL | PL/SQL | JIRA | TestRail | UNIX | API Testing | Data Validation | Workflow Automation | Confluence

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

FIS Global Solutions - Senior Lead Analyst BA

June 2017 - Present | Pune, India

Owned and delivered large-scale regulatory payment transformation initiatives across clearing, settlement, netting, and ISO 20022 / SWIFT MX platforms for tier-1 banks.

Delivered 50+ detailed user stories with acceptance criteria, reducing rework by 20% and improving delivery.

Applied AI-enabled prioritisation techniques within SAFe® to support data-driven backlog decisions and maintain customer value focus at scale.

Accountable for end-to-end MT to MX migration and ISO 20022 compliance, ensuring adherence to external regulatory mandates and internal governance timelines.

Owned backlog prioritisation across regulatory and client-driven change, balancing compliance risk, operational impact, and engineering capacity.

Acted as primary client and stakeholder interface, driving requirement sign-off, managing regulatory expectations, and supporting controlled production releases.

Led SAFe® delivery cadence, including PI Planning, backlog refinement, and sprint execution to ensure continuous regulatory value delivery.

Partnered with engineering teams to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities, and ensure high-quality delivery across multiple releases.



FIS Global Solutions - Senior Analyst

July 2015 – June 2017|Pune, India

Served as SME for payment systems, financial messaging, SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, and clearing workflows, supporting senior delivery and regulatory initiatives.

Collaborated with BAs and developers to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical implementation.

Improved system reliability through requirement clarification, defect reduction, and enhanced test coverage across the payment platform

Designed and executed test strategies for payment processing, clearing and settlement, and financial messaging modules.

Supported UAT, regression testing, and production validation for multiple global banking clients.

Mindtree Pvt. Ltd. - Senior Test Engineer

July 2010 – July 2015|Pune, India

Built a strong foundation in regulated capital markets environments, supporting validation of post-trade systems under exchange and audit controls.

Ensured compliance with exchange regulations and optimised testing processes for accuracy, repeatability, and audit readiness.

Worked on major NSE systems, including:

Closeout and Voluntary Closeout System

CROMA - Cross Margining

NGPT FnO - Next Generation Post Trade

NEAT Plus - Unified Front-End for Capital Markets, Currency Derivatives and FnO

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align testing activities with project timelines and business objectives.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.), Computer Science and Engineering Shivaji University, Kolhapur, India | 2006-2010

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified AI-Empowered SAFe® 6 Product Owner / Product Manager (POPM) - Scaled Agile | 2026

Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) - Scrum Alliance | 2025

Certified Scrum Master (CSM) - Scrum Alliance | 2025

Certified Team Kanban Practitioner - Lean University | 2018

NSE Certified Market Professional (NCMP Level 1) - National Stock Exchange | 2015

AWARDS and RECOGNITION

Laureate Award - FIS (2018, 2019, 2021)

Team Spot Award - Mindtree (2014)

10/10 Award - Mindtree (2013)
